completion:
Review the site photos and take note any separately coded access routes.
3. Verify any horizontally aligned photos.
4. Circle and number any breaks (parallel to the direction of travel) when orbitally viewing a 360-story board image.
5. Conduct an ADA audit to examine the relationship between each photographed section of the route using Step 1-4 as reference for direction. a. Begin where the entering accesses from the parking and complete the audit in the order (a relation to the parking).
6. Document the number of each section as they are listed on the report by recording in the workbook WHERE AS IS and INJURY.
7. Verify the inputs match when you are done. Please try not to use the word "none" when there is a break in the route.
